turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Liew, the anesthesiologist who'll be looking after you during your surgery. Can you confirm your full name and today's date for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, doctor. I'm Tan Kiah Choon, and today's 15th March. Surgery's for my gallbladder, right? They said something about stones causing pain.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Yes, you're scheduled for a laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Can you tell me more about your gallbladder issues? How long have you been having symptoms?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: About half a year already. Had bad pain after eating, especially oily food. Doctor said stones are blocking, so need to remove it lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understood. Now, let's go through your medications. Can you confirm your current list, especially any changes to your blood pressure medications?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I take Amlodipine 10mg every morning for BP. Used to be on Enalapril, but stopped six months back because of the cough side effect. Now only Amlodipine, plus Metformin for diabetes, Atorvastatin for cholesterol, Levothyroxine for thyroid, and Omeprazole but stopped that already.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you for clarifying that. So no Enalapril currently, only Amlodipine for hypertension. Any allergies we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No allergies, doctor. Never had reactions to any medicines or foods.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. You mentioned diabetes and high cholesterol – are these well-controlled with your current medications?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, doctor. Blood sugar and cholesterol levels are okay with the meds. BP also stable with Amlodipine.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. Have you had anything to eat or drink since midnight? We need to confirm you're NPO for surgery.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No food or water since last night, like the nurse instructed. Just a bit of water with my morning pills, but that was hours ago lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Any previous anesthesia experiences we should know about?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, this is my first surgery. Never had general anesthesia before.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright. How are you managing with daily activities? Any shortness of breath or chest pain on exertion?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No issues, doctor. Can climb stairs slowly and walk to the market without problems.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. We'll be using general anesthesia with a short-acting agent, and you'll have pain relief through a PCA pump after surgery. Any questions for me?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No questions, doctor. Just want to get this over with and feel better.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Of course. We'll take good care of you. I'll see you in the holding area before the operation.
